title: WLAN LDPC Decoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/WLAN_LDPC_Decoder.md
text: Decode LDPC code according to WLAN standard, 5 inputs, 5 outputs; {Standard} sets the type of standard IEEE, {Algorithm} sets the lDPC decoding algorithm, {Scaling factor}, {Decoding termination criteria} sets the termination criteria, {Source for number of iterations} sets the source selection for number of iterations, {Number of iterations} sets the number of decoding iterations, {Maximum number of iterations} sets the maximum number of decoding iterations and {Enable parity check output port} sets the parity check status. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Standard
params.values: Type of standard IEEE 802.11 n/ac/ax (default) | IEEE 802.11 ad

params.name: Algorithm
params.values: LDPC decoding algorithm Min-sum (default) | Normalized min-sum

params.name: Scaling factor
params.values: Scaling factor for normalized min-sum decoding 0.75 (default) | scalar in the range from 0.5 to 1, incremented by 0.0625

params.name: Source for number of iterations
params.values: Source selection for number of iterations Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Number of iterations
params.values: Number of decoding iterations 8 (default) | integer in the range from 1 to 63

params.name: Maximum number of iterations
params.values: Maximum number of decoding iterations 8 (default) | integer in the range from 1 to 63
